message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the main tools, platforms, and APIs you can tap into if you’re looking to book flights programmatically or via a website:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers |
|----------|----------------|----------------|
| **Flight Search & Booking APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** (https://developers.amadeus.com/) | Full‑fledged flight search, availability, pricing, and booking. Includes seat selection, e‑ticket issuance, and ancillary services. |
| | **Skyscanner Rapid API** (https://rapidapi.com/skyscanner/api/skyscanner-flight-search) | Cheap flight price comparison, multi‑city itineraries, and price alerts. |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Travel SDK) | Flight search, pricing, and itinerary building. Requires OAuth and is part of the Google Cloud ecosystem. |
| | **Travelport Universal API** | Enterprise‑grade flight inventory, booking, and ticketing across multiple carriers. |
| | **Expedia Rapid API** (https://expedia.com/rapid-api) | Flight search + hotel + car rental bundling. |
| | **Kayak API** (via RapidAPI) | Aggregated flight prices, fare alerts, and booking links. |
| | **OpenSky API** (https://opensky-network.org/apidoc/index.html) | Real‑time flight status and historical data – useful for dynamic flight tracking. |
| | **FlightAware API** (https://flightaware.com/commercial/firehose/documentation.php) | Live flight tracking, status updates, and historical flight data. |
| | **Airline Direct APIs** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Many major carriers expose their own booking APIs for direct integration. |
| **Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)** | **Booking.com**, **Hotels.com**, **Priceline**, **Orbitz** | These sites often provide “Book Now” widgets or partner APIs for flight + hotel packages. |
| | **TripAdvisor Flights** | Aggregates flight options and integrates with local travel services. |
| **Aggregators & Meta‑Search Engines** | **Google Flights**, **Kayak**, **Momondo**, **Skyscanner**, **Hipmunk** | Offer price comparison and link users to carrier or OTA booking pages. |
| **Mobile SDKs** | **Amadeus Mobile SDK** | iOS/Android libraries for embedding flight search and booking flows directly into apps. |
| | **Skyscanner SDK** | Similar mobile integration for flight search and booking. |
| **Payment & Ticketing** | **Stripe Connect** (for handling payments) | Can be paired with any booking API to handle payment processing. |
| | **SITA eTicketing** | Standard for issuing electronic tickets once a booking is confirmed. |

### How to Use Them

1. **Choose an API** – Pick one that fits your region, budget, and feature set (e.g., Amadeus for full booking flow, Skyscanner for price comparison).
2. **Register & Get Credentials** – Sign up on the provider’s developer portal, obtain API keys or OAuth tokens.
3. **Read the Docs** – Each platform has extensive documentation covering endpoints, rate limits, and sample requests.
4. **Integrate** – Use REST calls (JSON payloads) to search for flights, retrieve availability, and submit bookings. Most APIs support standard HTTP methods (`GET` for search, `POST` for booking).
5. **Handle Payment** – If the API doesn’t handle payments, integrate a payment gateway (Stripe, PayPal) and pass the transaction ID back to the booking service.
6. **Issue Tickets** – After confirmation, use the airline’s e‑ticketing endpoint or the provider’s ticket issuance API to generate the PDF/e‑ticket.
7. **Track Status** – Optionally hook into real‑time flight status APIs (OpenSky, FlightAware) to keep customers updated.

---

#### Quick Tips

- **Rate Limits** – Be mindful of daily call quotas; many providers offer higher tiers for enterprise usage.
- **Compliance** – Ensure you comply with GDPR, PCI‑DSS, and any airline-specific regulations.
- **Testing** – Use sandbox environments where available (most APIs provide a test mode).

If you’d like a deeper dive into a specific API or help setting up a prototype, let me know!
